name: Separation Margin Under Union Along a Cube
statement: If realizable ample pieces share a full cube and otherwise use disjoint private coordinate blocks, their embedded union has margin between $t^2/(1+2t)$ and $t$, where $t$ is the least piece margin; the lower bound is sharp for unions of single-edge pieces.
proof: Average each piece certificate on the common cube, shrink occupied-piece witnesses, and use the averaged witnesses on all other private blocks. Piece rows and cross-block two-positive rows then have common slack $t^2/(1+2t)$.
